FIELDS.NAME: Sole Revival Shoe Store & Repair

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sole Revival Shoe Store & Repair operates as a retail establishment specializing in the sale of various types of footwear, including casual, athletic, and formal shoes. In addition to offering a diverse selection of shoes, we provide on-site shoe repair services, carried out by skilled technicians using standard, low-risk equipment. Our operations prioritize customer satisfaction, with a focus on maintaining a clean, well-organized store that complies with all local safety codes. Our staff undergoes regular safety and operational training to ensure they are equipped with the knowledge to assist customers effectively while minimizing risks. We do not engage in any equipment rental or leasing activities, allowing us to maintain a focused business model that emphasizes quality products and services. Our commitment to safety and compliance is reflected in our documented training and minimal incident history, ensuring a positive shopping experience for our customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sole Revival Footwear and Accessories, LLC
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
Loss 1: 02/15/2022, water damage due to a burst pipe, $800.00, resolved with insurance.  
Loss 2: 07/10/2023, theft of inventory, $400.00, status unresolved, investigation ongoing.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, Grade 1, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with regular monitoring and response protocol.
